new_libraries.name: RelinkIoT
new_libraries.author: Relink IoT
new_libraries.sentence: Build IoT projects you can monitor and control from anywhere.
new_libraries.paragraph: Build your own IoT projects and monitor or control them from anywhere with ReLink IoT. Connect ESP32 and ESP8266 devices to collect sensor data, control relays and other outputs, and create connected applications using virtual pins. ReLink IoT supports encrypted communication, direct device-to-device connections, automatic relay fallback, and OTA firmware updates, with camera streaming on supported ESP32 boards.

library.name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
library.author: Aung Moe Khine
library.sentence: Universal standalone TFT, touch, sprite, hardware terminal, onboard audio, battery telemetry, 80MHz SPI stress test & tear-free raster animation driver with 1-line autoSetup and adaptive autoCalibrate for ESP32/S3 CYD resistive & capacitive boards and ESP32-S3 RGB capacitive boards.
library.paragraph: Bundles high-speed display and touch drivers with runtime hardware auto-probing for 2.4", 2.8", 3.2", 3.5", and 4.0" CYD resistive and capacitive boards (ILI9341, ST7789, ST7796, GC9307, XPT2046, GT911, CST820, FT6336, CHSC6540) including ESP32-S3 SPI displays (VIEWE UEDX24320028, ES3C28P) and ESP32-S3 parallel RGB boards (4.3", 5.0", 7.0" 800x480 ST7262 + GT911 capacitive touch). Features certified 80 MHz SPI bus stress testing with NVS persistence (tft.stressTest()), unbuffered tear-free Raster Animation with zero framebuffer, hardware scanline Beam Chasing (command 0x45), panel refresh rate tuning (tft.applyRefreshChoice(), tft.setRefreshStep()), ultra-fast AMK_Terminal (5 KB RAM hardware-scrolling text console), onboard PAM8302 audio amplifier enable & pop-free tone generation (tft.enableAudio(), tft.playBeep()), calibrated ADC battery telemetry (tft.getBatteryVoltage(), tft.getBatteryPercentage()), 1-line universal SD card mounting (tft.initSD()), 1-line hardware auto-setup (tft.autoSetup()), adaptive multi-point statistical touch calibration with NVS persistence (tft.autoCalibrate()), ambient light auto-dimming with LDR moving average filtering (tft.adjustBrightness()), universal Active-LOW RGB LED control, persistent NVS hardware overrides, full TFT_eSPI and TFT_eSPI_Button compatibility, linear gradients, alpha blending, TFT_eSprite buffering, LVGL v8/v9 integration, and seamless SquareLine Studio / EEZ Studio support.
